new_accepted_concepts.label: Strategies for Effective Group Discussion
new_accepted_concepts.description: Practical techniques to improve group decision-making, including encouraging all members to participate and thoroughly discussing the advantages and disadvantages of each option before deciding.
coverage_criteria: Student can explain why encouraging broad participation and discussing pros and cons lead to better group decisions.
new_accepted_concepts.merge_rationale: Both candidates are high-level actionable strategies from the same source and together form a cohesive concept about improving group discussions.

existing_concept_candidate_additions.explanation: Groupthink is a risk of consensus-seeking, and supermajority is a common fallback, so these nuances are best represented within the broader Decision by Consensus concept.
